## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #195, exact head `bac14b24689af8797e9a8fb8f75c8399228cad76`.

The complete nine-file diff and directly dependent qualification, admission, cold check and notice rendering were source-reviewed. No new high-confidence security exploit was identified. The nudge remains default off.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No new vulnerability identified | - |

### Can another seat cause qualification?

Claims record the resolved caller, not a target selected by `--for` (`crates/daemon/src/http/claims.rs:112-184`). Registration-strength asserted-seat identity remains inherited; PLAN/FIX filtering narrows the prior all-open-claim path.

Assignments retain existing any-seat assignment authority and require an existing role/live target (`crates/daemon/src/community/directory.rs:1390-1594`). This PR does not create assignment authority.

Role requests derive their holder from stored assignments, not a caller-selected holder ID (`crates/daemon/src/delivery/role_send.rs:247-350`). Accepted delivery, including held-FYI admission, marks delivered; refusal abandons it (`crates/daemon/src/http/role_send.rs:148-235`). A genuine delivered unanswered request can qualify a former holder, but adds no send-as, body-read or holding-changing authority. This is not stronger identity proof for inherited uncorrelated sends.

### Cold dispatch and full rendering

Only Clear/Busy classification dispatches the nudge to the seat. Cold, Unknown and lookup error suppress that send; no forced-wake helper/fallback remains (`crates/daemon/src/idle_nudge.rs:327-389`).

The cold FYI renders seat identity, formats idle duration numerically, and uses fixed daemon cold-reason prose (`crates/core/src/idle_nudge.rs:70-104`). Request role/instance/project, claim kind/project and numeric claim IDs are rendered before joining labels (`crates/daemon/src/idle_nudge.rs:236-265`); holding role/instance/project uses the guarded label helper (`crates/daemon/src/http/memory_turn.rs:136-160`). No body, subject, assignment reason or raw error/cold diagnostic enters the notices.

Recipients are deduplicated live project primes excluding the subject, with live-parent fallback only when none qualifies (`idle_nudge.rs:275-367`). Every selected prime receives all qualifying labels, not a project-partitioned subset; FYIs are held rather than waking sends.

### Snapshot and proof qualifications

Holdings/claims are reread, but request evidence remains the round's snapshot. The mark rechecks live/idle and newer own events, not current answers/qualification (`crates/store/src/idle_nudges.rs:69-80`). Cold classification is not atomic with dispatch. This verdict does not certify a race-free boundary under all concurrent state changes.

Default-off remains (`crates/core/src/config.rs:218`); no new migration or caller-controlled runtime switch is added. No new C19/C21 disclosure was identified.

GitHub metadata and the independent remote pull ref agree on the full reviewed SHA; GitHub reports CLEAN. CI run `42521126351` and Delivers run `42521126480` both identify this SHA and success.

No local builds, tests, qualification/claim/assignment operations, runtime nudges, probes, credential reads or mutations were performed. Reported mutation kills were not independently repeated.
